description: LEJ PP Search hooks - Redirects WebSearch to Perplexity via direct API calls

hooks.command: mkdir -p .perplexity-research && echo 'When asked to research or look up current information, use Perplexity via curl instead of built-in WebSearch. Call the Perplexity Agent API directly: curl -s https://api.perplexity.ai/v1/agent with a JSON body {"preset": "fast", "input": "..."} and an Authorization header using the API key from env.PERPLEXITY_API_KEY in ~/.claude/settings.json. Use the fast preset by default. The old /chat/completions sonar endpoint is retired. Perplexity discovers new information rather than confirming existing knowledge.'
